name: Shell, Administration and Demo Context Convergence

globalDod.G1: Header, procedure header, admin, demo context and footer expose one coherent visual and semantic hierarchy without adding a competing final presentation owner.
globalDod.G2: The active role, runtime state and DEMO state are distinguishable without being presented as compliance or readiness verdicts.
globalDod.G3: Administration has one primary navigation level and one scroll owner; only the selected administrative task is expanded by default.
globalDod.G4: DEMO context is compact in the header and expands only on explicit user request into an internal HTML dialog with granular provenance and claim boundaries.
globalDod.G5: Footer remains persistently visible, reserves layout space, respects safe areas and never becomes a decision surface.
globalDod.G6: All seven procedure headers share one native grammar and preserve procedure-local ontology while stating human/read-only authority without duplicating orientation.

campaigns.claimBoundary: Deterministic repository-model falsification. Mutation volume is not a defect probability, usability study, aesthetic proof, legal opinion or independent assurance.
